shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents the hidden rear bottom edge DC of the cube. Right image: The dashed polyline is the plotted graph of function g, visually separated from solid graph f.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The visible y=g(x) label attaches the right dashes to the function curve itself. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
